arguments.summary: Coordinated investigation and response to a credential compromise incident involving user 'admin_jsmith'. Initial SSH brute-force attempt (INC-2026-1203A) was correlated with a dark web credential leak (INC-2026-1203B) and anomalous Kerberos access from an unauthorized device (INC-2026-1203C). Analysis confirmed the compromise originated from workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), which had been beaconing to a Cobalt Strike C2 server. The attacker used stolen credentials to move laterally and attempted access from another host (WS-IT-101, 10.0.2.15). All sessions and credentials for 'admin_jsmith' were revoked, the C2 IP was blocked at the firewall, and the infected host was scanned and hardened.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing patterns in network traffic or memory dumps"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "e86f10ba1a3c3d9f8b5c7a2d4e6f8a1c2b3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f"
    strings:
        $a = { 2D 73 6C 70 69 74 2D 78 6D 6C 2D 62 6C 6F 62 2D 30 31 30 30 } // '-split-xml-blob-0100'
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.1; Windows NT)" fullword ascii
        $c = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // 16 nulls, common in C2 configs
    condition:
        all of them
}
